a4AfterShatter.label: After a Shatter
a4AfterShatter.reason: Depends on the enemy being Frozen so that he can Shatter it, which needs a Hydro party member.

c4C6Stacks.label: Constellation 4 and 6 stacks
c4C6Stacks.reason: Stacks from Frozen, Shatter or Superconduct reactions, which depend on the party.

stalk.label: Subnautical Hunter mode
stalk.reason: His Burst puts him in Subnautical Hunter mode, where his Skill is used most, and doubles the frost of his Skill there.
